# Con-Gen Media

> Con-Gen Media is a digital media agency founded by Asim Yousafzai (AK Yousafzai). It edits YouTube videos, Shorts and reels, and makes motion graphics, thumbnails and ad creatives for creators and brands worldwide.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.congenmedia.com/): agency overview and showreel
- [Services](https://www.congenmedia.com/services): video editing, Shorts, motion graphics, thumbnails, ad creatives
- [Packages](https://www.congenmedia.com/packages): packages for creators and brands
- [Work](https://www.congenmedia.com/work): portfolio
- [Founder](https://www.congenmedia.com/founder): Asim Yousafzai
- [Motion Prompts](https://www.congenmedia.com/prompts/): free motion-design prompts
- [Blog](https://www.congenmedia.com/blog/): video editing and AI tools guides
